notes: The page calls it the first youth-focused participatory budgeting initiative in the United States.
name: Youth Lead the Change
org: Office of Youth Engagement and Advancement, City of Boston
what_you_do: Boston youth submit project ideas, help shape proposals and vote on how the City spends $1 million in City funds each year.
pay_detail: Not a job. Youth take part in the civic process.
duration: Yearly cycle: ideas, proposals, voting, then projects built
deadline_text: Now in the project building phase. The next voting cycle date is not posted. Sign up for the newsletter and follow @oyeaboston.
how_to_apply: Submit ideas online, at workshops or at community meetings when a cycle opens. Vote online or on paper ballots. Contact: 617-961-6980.
